newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: FCL Building confident of its market.
newsitem.headline: FCL Building confident of its market.

text.p: Fletcher Challenge Building said on Wednesday that it was confident that New Zealand market conditions would remain positive.
FCL Building said housing starts were set to rise after a decline in 1996. Remodelling expenditure should rise, assisted by cuts in tax, and infrastructure spending would "almost certainly" increase.

"The Auckland region is likely to enjoy continuing above-average growth and FCL Building's major presence in the Auckland market is a significant plus in this regard. The Australian economy is also improving and housing starts should begin to lift during the current year."
FCL Building should start to see earnings flowing from the expansion initiatives, such as FCL Aluminium and from other initiatives in train to extract more value from existing operations.

FCL Building earlier announced net earnings of NZ$121 million in the year to June, up from $117 million a year earlier. The result included a positive tax provision of NZ$36 million, arising mainly from losses by the offshore construction operations.
